title: 21 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Bhagwan Swaminarayan begins the discourses recorded in the Vachanamrut
story: In Gadhada, Bhagwan Swaminarayan begins delivering the discourses recorded in the Vachanamrut. This first Vachanamrut was titled "Akhand Vruttinu" (Continuously Engaging One’s Mind on God).
story_short: On this day in 1819, in Gadhada, Bhagwan Swaminarayan delivered the first discourse recorded in the Vachanamrut.

options.headline: Dev Diwali 2010 in Bochasan
options.story:
A grand annakut was arranged before the deities in the mandir. Swamishri performed arti in all three shrines. The theme of this morning’s celebration assembly was ‘Shastriji Maharaj’s endeavours in spreading the upasana of Akshar-Purushottam’. The programme included: Traditional dance: youths of Gana mandal Glory of Festivals: Sarvamangal Swami Unity, Sacrifice and Satpurush: Brahmavihari Swami Development of BAPS on Principles: Viveksagar Swami Unity, Base of the Sanstha’s Development: Tyagvallabh Swami Drama: Sacrifice Sacrifice, Base of the Sanstha’s Development: Kothari Swami Satpurush, Essence of the Sanstha’s Development: Mahant Swami Traditional Dance: youths Swamishri’s blessings.

In his blessings Swamishri stressed upon the power of God as the main element in the development and progress of BAPS. Swamishri also eulogized upon the life and work of Shastriji Maharaj. More than 20,000 devotees attended the festival assembly.

A thal for the guru parampara too

Today was the auspicious day of Kartiki Purnima. On this day an Annakut is arranged here. Today Pramukh Swami Maharaj had darshan of this Annakut. Every year the seva of this Annakut here is received from Arvindbhai Saheb of Nairobi.

Swamishri performed the arti of Thakorji along with the Annakut in all three shrines, and after that went for darshan in the shrine of the guru parampara on the circumambulation path. Here, not seeing an Annakut thal before the murtis of the guru parampara, Swamishri at once asked, "Why has no thal been offered here?"

The pujari said, "Only one thal is kept here; we offer it in turn."

Swamishri said, "What is done every day is fine, but today is the Annakut, so it should be offered in all the shrines." Saying this, Swamishri sent instructions to the storekeeper to prepare an Annakut thal.

No tip top

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was certainly eager to go to the festival of Kartiki Purnima, so when the time came, Swamishri began to hurry. Swamishri was seated in the wheelchair. Since he was in the wheelchair, sandals were not really needed, but Brahmvihari Swami, standing nearby, said, "If you wear sandals it will look a little nicer. One should stay tip top like this."

As soon as he heard this, Swamishri said, "Don't make things tip top at all. We should live just as God keeps us, and do bhajan. So many have perished in being tip top."

Brahmvihari Swami said, "What I meant was to stay well ordered."

Swamishri said, "Tip top means a muddle; understand it that way."

Swamishri always believes in simplicity. He does not like rajogun (showiness).

BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir, Bochasan. Bids Jai Swaminarayan to bhaktas. Engaged in darshan of Shri Nilkanth Varni abhishek guru Parampara. During the assembly. Blesses the assembly. BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir, Bochasan. Annakut offered to Shri Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj. Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj. Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Shri Lakshmi-Narayan Dev. Kids perform a dance before Bapa on mandir grounds. Dev Diwali Celebration assembly - Bapa and senior sadhus on stage. Honoured by sadhus.

options.headline: Mulji Sharma leaves everything in Bhadra at the call of Shriji Maharaj
options.story: In Bhadra, Mulji Bhakta was busy diverting water to his sugarcane field situated by the riverbank. He was thinking about when Shriji Maharaj would instruct him to renounce this world. Suddenly, he had a vision of Shriji Maharaj in the sky. Maharaj was wearing a yellow pitambar and a southern-style pagh.
options.whatsapp: On this day in 1809, Mulji Sharma, later Gunatitanand Swami, left his work in Bhadra at once when Shriji Maharaj called him.

options.headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj Janma Jayanti Celebrations BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London, UK
options.story:
The birth anniversary of Pramukh Swami Maharaj was celebrated with great devotion on the evenings of Saturday 21 November 2009, Wednesday 25 November 2009 and Saturday 28 November 2009 at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London. The celebrations on Saturday 21 November 2009 were themed ‘Yugo Sudhi Aa Jagma…’, based around a collection of testimonies of the life-enhancing inspiration that Swamishri has provided to various devotees around the world.

Following a touching video presentation depicting the personal qualities and compassionate nature of Swamishri, Yagnatilak Swami shared inspiring examples of devotees in Paris and Lisbon whose lives had been transformed for the better by Swamishri. Kishores, yuvaks and vadils later sang a special prarthna called ‘Janam divase karu prarthna’, before Yogvivek Swami narrated important episodes from the life of Swamishri.

The finale to the evening programme was a lively dance by the yuvaks who conveyed the words of the theme-bhajan ‘Yugo sudhi aa jagma jena malata raheshe ajvala…’. The celebrations also coincided with the visit of Archbishop of Westminster, The Most Reverend Vincent Nichols (Head of the Roman Catholic Church for England and Wales), and the culmination of National Inter Faith Week.

Representatives of the major faiths came together to light a lamp as a symbol of their commitment to peace, harmony and the common good. Yogvivek Swami welcomed the guests with Swamishri’s message of interfaith respect and understanding, and the Archbishop also addressed the assembly. (Click here for a full report.) The actual birth day according to the Hindu calendar (Magshar sud 8) was celebrated on Wednesday 25 November 2009.

Sadhus began the evening assembly with dhun and prarthna. Prabuddhmuni Swami, Munibhushan Swami and others narrated inspiring episodes from Swamishri’s life, which were all interspersed with short video presentations. A dance then followed where the murtis of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Swamishri were carried into the assembly hall on a decorated palanquin.

Yogvivek Swami concluded the evening by touching on the service of Swamishri and encouraging everyone to adopt his virtues in their lives. The Mahila Mandal celebrated the Janma Jayanti of Pramukh Swami Maharaj on Saturday 28 November 2009. The evening began with a colourful dance followed by an insightful presentation led by the Yuvati Mandal covering Swamishri’s entire life and his commitment to the wishes of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and his guru Shastriji Maharaj, and his selfless dedication and service for the joy of others.

This message was elaborated upon and supported by a series of inspiring videos and speeches which described the manner in which Pramukh Swami Maharaj has positively transformed the lives of so many. The Balika Mandal concluded the programme by offering prayers for all to be able to serve and please Swamishri through a noble, upright life.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s birth anniversary was also celebrated at other BAPS mandirs and centres around the UK, including Ashton-under-Lyne, Birmingham, Coventry, Leicester, Loughborough, Nottingham, Preston, Wellingborough, and various boroughs of London, as well as at major centres in Europe.
